english.notes:
(i) 'Corrosive product' applies to the substances listed in Schedule 1 and any products which contain a substance listed in the Schedule with concentration limits higher than the limits set, as defined in section 1(11).
(ii) 'Corrosive product' does not include a substance or product contained in a battery subsection as stated in section 1(15).
(iii) A 'locker' means a lockable container to which a corrosive substance is delivered with a view to collection by the buyer or a person acting on behalf of the buyer, as defined within section 3(7).
(iv) A defence is available at section 3(8) when a person takes all reasonable precautions and exercises due diligence.
(v) A similar offence to this as to delivery to residential premises under section 3(2) is given in H20283.
(vi) Please note the transitional requirement in regulation 3 of SI 2022/418 – stating this offence does not apply where, before 6th April 2022, the seller arranges for the delivery of a corrosive product and the delivery has not taken place by that date.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 51 weeks imprisonment in relation to summary offences is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
